idea-plugin.name: Opt Chain
idea-plugin.description:
Supports JavaScript-style optional chaining ?. in Java sources for the java-opt-chain toolchain.

  • Suppresses illegal-token / red-line errors on ?.
  • Highlights ?. operators, completes fields and methods, and navigates to them
  • Before IDEA's Java compiler runs, rewrites ?. to OptChainOps.opt(receiver) (the same transform as Maven opt-chain:preprocess) and weaves the class files so Run/Debug short-circuits null receivers
  • Keeps target/generated-sources/opt-chain and target/opt-chain from being a second source root (no duplicate class next to src/main/java)

Maven preprocess + weave remain the source of truth for command-line builds. After installing, use File → Invalidate Caches… → Invalidate and Restart, then reimport Maven.

Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ through 2025.2 (build 241–252+).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.1 — IDEA build rewrites ?. to OptChainOps.opt and weaves class files, so Run/Debug works without a prior Maven preprocess. Maven mirrors are not IDE source roots (fixes duplicate class on target/generated-sources/opt-chain).

0.2.0 — Plugin id and implementation package are now io.github.chensirj.optchain.idea. Uninstall the old plugin (id io.ch.java.opt.chain.idea) before installing this build. Editor behavior is unchanged from 0.1.2.

0.1.2 — Field chains share completion and navigation with methods. Go to Declaration falls back to a field of the qualifier type when resolve() is empty. Highlight filters unchanged.

0.1.1 — Stronger red-squiggle suppression (HighlightInfoFilter + wider ?. matching); explicit 2025.2 / build 252 support.

0.1.0 — Initial release: error filter, highlight, completion, navigation.
